title: Sign in
introJoining: Sign in to join the association. You'll come straight back to the invitation afterwards.
intro: You sign in with your Google account. The meeting notes are saved in the association's meeting folder or in your own Google Drive.
onlyOwnDocs: We may only create and edit the documents Simon Says creates itself. We don't see the rest of your Drive.
onlyStarter: Everyone in the room can take part without an account. With one, you get your tasks and summaries.
privacy: Read how we handle audio, text and accounts in the <link>privacy information</link>.
scopeCaption: When Google asks, tick this box:
scopeRow: See, edit, create and delete only the specific Google Drive files that you use with this app
scopeRowSr: The box says: See, edit, create and delete only the specific Google Drive files that you use with this app.
signedInAgainText: Close this tab. The meeting continues in the other tab, and what was waiting is being sent now.
